prompt: Explain why ocean tides happen and why the Moon has a stronger tidal effect on Earth than the Sun despite the Sun being more massive.

correct_answer: Ocean tides are mainly caused by gravitational differences across Earth and the Moon has a stronger tidal effect because it is much closer than the Sun

prompt: Explain why boiling point changes with altitude.
